basis: Fresh Ghidra export bound to the current Docker candidate, normalized Ghidra C and P-Code equality, exact 20-instruction AArch64 and relocation parity, two reproducible Docker builds, strict Joern scope/slice, matching KCFI type ID and lifecycle host coverage.
limitations: This is static/offline function-level evidence; IR hardware behavior remains unverified.
The exact island preserves the stock release callback and does not claim the surrounding C safety implementation is behaviorally identical.
The host harness uses kernel and SPI stubs; live kernel, DMA and bus-fault behavior require runtime validation.
The promotion does not claim that the remaining unpromoted zte_ir functions are complete.
